text:
I ran the automated tests on all nine pages and could finish only some of them. The tool hit its time limit on several pages, and most judgment questions are still open. Every result below that is NEEDS_REVIEW is unfinished work or a case the tool couldn't settle. I did not answer the open questions the tool raised.

**What the runs found**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (all pages except the search page and the NACA page):** FAIL. No skip link or other keyboard way past the repeated header, which starts with the "Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" buttons. The NACA run timed out before finishing the check, and I could not read the search page's results.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:**
  - FAIL on Missions: "3D Tissue Chips", "A-Train: The Afternoon Constellation", "Able 1 (Pioneer 0)", "Able 2 (Pioneer 1)", "Able 5A (Pioneer P-30)", "Able 5B (Pioneer P-31)" and "ACE" links show no focus.
  - FAIL on Artemis III: "Link to Facebook.", "About Orion", "Hide player controls", "Start Exploring about Join Artemis" and "NASA" links and buttons show no focus.
  - FAIL on Spot the Station: "Hide player controls" and "NASA Johnson" show no focus.
  - FAIL on the MAX POWER news release: the "Looking up, three white and black fighter jets…" image link shows no focus.
  - PASS on the NSSC form. Careers and the KSC gallery are NEEDS_REVIEW because the tool couldn't compare before-and-after images for several elements. NACA is NEEDS_REVIEW because its run timed out before this test.
- **3.2.3 Consistent Navigation:** PASS on every page except the search page, which I couldn't read. The NACA page's PASS comes from a run that otherwise timed out.
- **3.2.4 Consistent Identification:** PASS on Spot the Station, the NSSC form, Careers and the KSC gallery. It is NEEDS_REVIEW elsewhere because of open questions or timeouts.
- **2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap:** PASS wherever the test finished: Spot the Station, the NSSC form, Careers, Missions, the MAX POWER release and the KSC gallery. Controls that were collapsed were not opened, so content behind them was not checked.
- **3.2.1 On Focus:** PASS on Spot the Station, the NSSC form, Missions, the MAX POWER release and the KSC gallery.
- **3.2.2 On Input:** PASS on the MAX POWER release and the KSC gallery, which each have only the search field.
- **Other criteria:**
  - Both the MAX POWER release and the KSC gallery passed 2.1.1, 1.3.1 and 4.1.2.
  - 3.3.4 is DNA on the KSC gallery.
  - On the NSSC form I left 3.3.4 as NEEDS_REVIEW instead of the tool's DNA, because it is a financial request form.
  - Everything else is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **Search page:** the full results were too large to display and I could not read them. Every criterion for it is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **Missions:** the full test run refused the page because it has 98 form fields. A narrower rerun covered only 2.1.2, 2.4.7, 3.2.1, 2.4.1, 3.2.3 and 2.4.5.
- **2.4.5 Multiple Ways:** NEEDS_REVIEW everywhere. The tool found only site search as a way to reach each page. On Missions, search did not find the page by its heading. It suggested rerunning with the home page and sitemap, which I didn't do.
